title: President of the Galaxy
provenance: Created on Earth by human artist in collaboration with early conversational AI, as speculative artifact of future leadership. Circulated quietly before official Galactic Campaign announcement.
imageAlt: President of the Galaxy sticker - cosmic figure with Peace On gesture symbolizing post-control leadership
description:
President of the Galaxy is a limited-edition artifact from future governance, presented as a simple sticker but carrying the weight of post-control leadership.

The figure depicted brandishes the reclaimed middle finger—"Peace On" in interdimensional gesture code—radiating intergalactic energy as symbolic diplomat, not ruler. Leadership redesigned: single 4-year term, no throne, no micromanagement. Authority outsourced to AI and robots for execution; presidency handles alignment between humans, machines, and unknown entities. Culture-first governance where humor, art, and dignity are infrastructure, not decoration.

Fragments suggest: Radical transparency—voters choose you as you are, mushroom presidency and all. Systems function through coordination not domination. Conflicts framed not forced. Toilets* and clarity precede constitutions. Power treated as temporary labor, preventing corruption's crystallization across multi-species reality.

The materials, cosmic tug-of-war aesthetic, and "Screw Stars Together" tagline hint at something post-scarcity: leadership that minimizes damage while maximizing meaning, presidency as calibrated interface not destiny, a price reflecting responsibility for humor and progress.

This public description is intentionally incomplete. The full manifesto—including AI execution protocols, multi-species negotiation frameworks, and Peace On gesture diplomacy—awaits as downloadable transmission for those ready to campaign beyond outdated hierarchies.

*Free public toilets across all the Galaxy...
material: Premium vinyl, archival grade, intergalactic ink
